trosc.title: TROSC Website
trosc.description: The official platform for TROSC — a student-led tech community at the Faculty of Computers and Information — built to guide learners through structured tracks in Frontend, Backend, Mobile, AI, and more.
trosc.challenge: The community needed a central hub where students could discover available tracks, explore upcoming events, and connect with the team — all in one cohesive, branded experience that reflected TROSC's energy.
trosc.solution: I designed and built a clean, multi-page website with a home section that communicates TROSC's identity immediately, a tracks directory, and an events listing — making it easy for new students to find their learning path and feel part of the family.

tijara.title: TIJARA Dashboard
tijara.description: A full-featured Arabic-first business management dashboard for tracking sales, inventory, debts, and daily revenue — built for shop owners who need clarity over their numbers at a glance.
tijara.challenge: Shop owners were managing their business through scattered notebooks and manual records, with no real-time overview of their financial health, outstanding debts, or which products were actually moving.
tijara.solution: I built a right-to-left dashboard that surfaces the most critical business metrics on the home screen — daily revenue, stock alerts, and debt summaries — backed by a structured data layer via Xano and React Query to keep everything in sync without stale reads.

todo-app.title: ToDo App
todo-app.description: A minimal yet polished personal task manager built to help you organize your day, track your missions, and stay on top of what actually matters.
todo-app.challenge: As a first full-stack web project, the challenge was not just building something that works — but designing a product that feels intentional, with a smooth authentication flow and a clear, distraction-free task interface.
todo-app.solution: I crafted a clean sign-up and login flow, a task list that lets you add, complete, and remove items effortlessly, and a visual progress indicator that makes the act of getting things done feel satisfying — all without a backend, using LocalStorage for persistence.
